name: @luciola/core
description: Lightweight, resilient LAN peer discovery and interface intelligence for Node.js

scripts.build: cargo build && cp $(cargo metadata --format-version 1 | grep -o '"target_directory":"[^"]*' | cut -d '"' -f 4)/debug/libluciola_node.dylib ./luciola.node 2>/dev/null || cp target/debug/libluciola_node.dylib ./luciola.node
